exposure: myasthenia gravis with stable disease during pregnancy
myasthenia gravis with deterioration during pregnancy
myasthenia gravis with improvement during pregnancy
outcome: preterm premature rupture of the membranes
cohort: 27 pregnancies in 12 patients with myasthenia gravis
finding: Pregnancies with deterioration of MG were statistically more likely to have higher miscarriage, preterm birth, PPROM, CS, and transient neonatal MG rates, in addition to a lower gestational age at birth, birth weight, and 5-min Apgar score than pregnancies with improved or stable disease.
